cohort: Three patients with congenital craniopharyngiomas (cCPs) diagnosed prenatally or on the second day of life.
finding: All three patients with cCPs survived, with one developing psychomotor retardation and mild hemiparesis, highlighting the potential for improved prognosis with early diagnosis and treatment.
gest_age: Prenatal diagnosis, specific gestational age not mentioned
followup_time: Range: 11-51 days of age at tumor resection, longer-term follow-up not specified
